**Elm Gully Residents' Association – General Meeting, 1 Oct 2026**

**Council update (Cr Morgan Tse):**
- Banksia Street footpath: work starts February, about six weeks.
- Gully Reserve playground upgrade (flying fox, accessible swing): April.
- Feedback on draft tree canopy plan due 31 October.

**Finances:** Balance $5,610; 142 member households, up on last year.

**Decisions:**
- Clean Up Day: Sunday 15 November, 8am, scout hall. Laila Haddad coordinating; council supplies bags, gloves and skip.
- Christmas carols: Saturday 12 December, 6:30pm, Gully Reserve. Budget up to $900. Peter Vance booking sound system.

**Other:** Tse will request a speed counter on Wattle Road. Facebook page to post meeting dates more clearly.

**Next meeting:** Thursday 3 December 2026.
